Allow this app to install updates in system settings, then continue installation again.

Automatic checks run about every 12 hours and may be delayed by system battery-saving policies. Downloads require a signed manifest and a complete APK signed with the original key. Installation still requires your action and system confirmation. Updating in place keeps local books; do not uninstall first. This feature does not update recognition rules.

There is no automatic time limit. A persistent notification is shown while running. Runtime status is saved and queued for upload about once a minute, which may use more battery. Stopping debugging also disables logging; saved logs can still be uploaded. It does not restart automatically after a force stop, permission revocation or system termination. Pages are not read while the screen is locked.
The previous debugging session was interrupted. Logging was not resumed automatically. An attempt was made to save the system exit reason. Enable logging and debugging again.
Recording diagnostics for selected apps and runtime status. Pages are not read while the screen is locked.
First consent to and enable logging above.
Allow notifications so background logging always has a visible stop control.
Continuous debugging could not run. Check notification and accessibility permissions, and storage.
Accessibility access is still granted, but the service is disconnected. If it remains disconnected, turn access off and back on in system settings.
Server confirmed receipt of %1$d log batches this time
Allow logging of selected app pages and transaction notifications?

Records accessibility events and readable pages from all package names listed below, not just transaction pages. If notification access is also granted, records suspected transaction notifications from all supported apps, including their titles, body text, expanded text, app package names, notification times and recognition results, to collect real notification templates. Unrecognized transaction notifications are also recorded. Ordinary chats, marketing messages and notifications containing verification codes or passwords are excluded. Long account numbers are masked, and system-hidden content is not bypassed. Logs may contain personal information, transaction text, amounts, merchants, orders, and OMyMoney rule decisions, cancellation reasons, recording results and errors. Passwords, input fields, lock-screen pages and sensitive pages are skipped or masked. The system may combine events, and protected content cannot be read. These are not internal logs of other apps. Logs use up to 16 MiB on this device. After pairing, they upload automatically to your server over HTTPS and are retained for up to 7 days, with earlier removal when capacity is low. Turning logging off immediately stops new samples, but does not delete saved logs or stop uploads of queued logs.

Additional apps are logged for diagnostics only. This does not add recognition or automatic recording rules.
Pairing code is invalid, used or expired. Ask the administrator to generate a new code.
Pairing did not complete. Check the network and storage. If the request reached the server, the code may already be used and a new one may be needed.

Pairing uploads currently queued logs and future logs. Codes are generated by the server administrator, valid for 24 hours and usable only once. Uploads may contain payment details. The book database and private attachments are not uploaded.
Unpairing removes only local credentials. It does not stop local logging or delete logs already on the server. Server-side revocation or deletion requires an administrator.
Exported files contain transaction text in plain text. Successfully uploaded batches have been removed from this device and are not included.
Queued: %1$d batches · %2$s\nServer confirmed receipt of %3$d log batches\nDropped log records: %4$d · Logging interruptions: %5$d (not necessarily crashes)
Accessibility access is not enabled in system settings. External app pages cannot be logged yet.
Operation did not complete. Check the network, your input or device storage and try again.

Bookkeeping and OCR still run on this device. Diagnostic uploads and app updates require internet access. The bundled ML Kit OCR SDK may also send operational metrics to its provider. This version does not guarantee that all network traffic is blocked.
